prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.2% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests, as neither test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Evidence is still thin for home flows (home, new_flow), path redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), as each has only 1 test.
Predictions were consistently too high and overly optimistic across tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -2.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Desktop Waiting Activity Flow: Introduces a companion tip carousel flow during the waiting phase so users can learn desktop pet interactions while waiting. (why: The waiting step has a long median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, and support emails show confusion about how to control pets after onboarding.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Centered Layout: Redesigns the path choice screen into a clean centered layout with structured path selection cards. (why: The choose_path step takes a mean time of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating substantial hesitation for some users.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Compact Layout: Rebuilds the photo upload view into a compact layout with direct image previews. (why: The adoption step has the lowest step conversion in the core funnel (60.9%) and long mean completion times (1017s).)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Preview Screen: Inserts a confirmation preview screen right after photo upload to confirm visual style before starting generation. (why: Support receives emails regarding custom pet creation failing or looking wrong after onboarding.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Sync Explanation Hint: Adds a hint explaining that signing in connects past adopted pets to this account to prevent account reset confusion. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Interaction Summary Copy: Updates the home intro screen copy to clearly explain how to reveal, hide, and interact with the pet on desktop. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Adds visual photo quality guidelines on the upload screen to ensure pet photo generation succeeds. (why: Support receives bug reports regarding custom pet generation failures and rendering issues.)
7: [finish, layout] Home Intro Centered Welcome Card: Changes the home intro layout to a clean centered view with clear action buttons. (why: Only 64.8% of users finish the home intro stage, losing users right at the final step.)

Supported by emails and funnel drop, but adding new screens previously reduced conversion.
